title: 🔆🔅Baghdad - Oct 18, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi made remarks on the sidelines of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) Council of Foreign Ministers.
text:
🔆🔅Baghdad - Oct 18, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi made remarks on the sidelines of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) Council of Foreign Ministers. "

""

"SOT1: "Serious discussions took place regarding Yemen, in this meeting [of OIC], the Saudis expressed their views, we expressed ours, and other countries did the same. A resolution was requested to be passed in this regard, but it has not yet been finalized.""

"SOT2: "We hope that fairness and balance are maintained in this resolution and in the final statement concerning the summit. Naturally, if this does not happen, the Islamic Republic of Iran will not be able to join them, and we will certainly reserve our position, separating ourselves from the issued resolutions, including that specific resolution. We might even explicitly declare our non-acceptance, depending on what the text of the resolution is. Naturally, the bloc of countries within the Organization of Islamic Cooperation that are close to Saudi Arabia's positions is a significant bloc; this is a reality that we must take into consideration. We have, of course, conducted extensive lobbying, and in my speech, I clearly stated what the fair solution is, and we hope that it will be taken into account.""

"SOT3: " [at UNGA] In New York, we presented our seven-point, seven-item, seven-day plan [to the U.S]. Here, we emphasized diplomatic ways, and countries are interested in this, as this region can no longer tolerate more threats and conflicts. They are interested in finding a peaceful solution, and the Islamic Republic is a pioneer in this matter and has shown its will on this path. Therefore, we are moving forward with both approaches simultaneously. The international community must know, and does know, that the Islamic Republic of Iran is a proponent of diplomacy, logic, and dialogue; at the same time, it is also a proponent of battle and struggle. If it is subjected to aggression, it will defend itself with strength. There is no contradiction between these two.""

"SOT4: "Our conditions are completely clear and have been presented to the American side in the form of the seven-day plan. They have provided comments that we are currently reviewing, but from our perspective, this plan is still on the table. If there were true sincerity on the American side, which there isn't, the path would be wide open. The Strait of Hormuz has a very specific route; if they comply with those conditions, the strait will be opened on the sixth day, and negotiations will be held on the seventh day.""

"SOT5:  "The conditions we have set are not strange or unusual; I have said this before. They are all conditions to which the United States had previously committed itself in the prior memorandum of understanding and in other negotiations. They are completely fair conditions, and we believe that if the United States has the will, it can fulfill these conditions within a few days, and the Strait of Hormuz will then be opened.
